title: Oath and Garden Anew
author: Ulyana Iversen
blurb: Lior Zhou, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
